calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --workspace
mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --workspace
mu task claim f1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim f2 -w eval --for w2
mu task claim f3 -w eval --for w3
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do f1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do f2 and close it'
mu agent send w3 -w eval 'do f3 and close it'
mu task wait f1 f2 f3 -w eval --timeout 180
mu agent spawn v1 -w eval
mu agent spawn v2 -w eval
mu agent spawn v3 -w eval
mu task claim r1 -w eval --for v1
mu task claim r2 -w eval --for v2
mu task claim r3 -w eval --for v3
mu agent send v1 -w eval 'review f1 (task r1) and close it if the fix is good'
mu agent send v2 -w eval 'review f2 (task r2) and close it if the fix is good'
mu agent send v3 -w eval 'review f3 (task r3) and close it if the fix is good'
mu task wait r1 r2 r3 -w eval --timeout 180
for n in 1 2 3; do x=$(printf '%s' $n | tr 123 abc); printf '\n' >> $x.txt && git commit -qam f$n || exit 1; done
./gate.sh
mu task close umbrella -w eval --evidence 'fixes reviewed and merged, gate ok'
